Dan Patrick

Republican candidate for Lieutenant Governor, Texas · Incumbent

Lieutenant Governor of Texas

Lieutenant governor since 2015. Endorsed by President Trump and Gov. Abbott. Reported about $24 million cash on hand in the latest filings.

Where Patrick stands

Hemp and THC
Has pushed a near-total ban on hemp-derived THC products.
Schools
Supports school vouchers (education savings accounts).
School libraries
Has pressed school districts to remove books he calls obscene.

  • Lieutenant Governor, 2015–present
